scenes.say: Single vision, bifocal or progressive. Which glasses do you actually need?

scenes.en: The lens inside your eye gets stiffer, so close-up focus gets harder.
scenes.say: After about forty, the lens inside your eye gets stiffer, so focusing up close gets harder.

scenes.en: One power. Best if you need help for one distance only.
scenes.say: Single vision lenses have one power. They are best if you need help for only one distance, far or near.

scenes.en: Two zones with a visible line: far on top, reading below.
scenes.ta: மேலே தூரம், கீழே படிக்க – நடுவில் கோடு
scenes.say: Bifocals have two zones with a visible line. Distance on top, reading below. The middle distance is missing.

scenes.en: No line. Far, middle and near in one smooth lens.
scenes.ta: கோடு இல்லை – தூரம், நடு, அருகு எல்லாம் ஒன்றில்
scenes.say: Progressives have no line. Far, middle and near flow smoothly in one lens, including your phone and computer.

scenes.en: It can take a week or two to get used to progressives.
scenes.ta: புரோகிரசிவ் லென்ஸுக்குப் பழக ஓரிரு வாரம் ஆகலாம்
scenes.say: Did you know? It can take a week or two to get used to progressives. Wear them all day, and turn your head, not just your eyes.

scenes.en: On spectacles with LenzKare Fusion lenses. Single vision lenses from ₹1,500.
scenes.ta: ஃப்யூஷன் லென்ஸுடன் ஒன்று வாங்கினால் ஒன்று இலவசம்
scenes.say: At LenzKare, get Buy One Get One Free on spectacles with Fusion lenses. Single vision lenses start from fifteen hundred rupees.

scenes.en: Free eye test in store. Home eye test: ₹100 for the whole family.
scenes.ta: வீட்டில் கண் பரிசோதனை – முழு குடும்பத்துக்கும் ரூ.100
scenes.say: Not sure which one you need? Get an eye test. It's free at our store, or just one hundred rupees for the whole family at home.
